title: JBL Professional Control 442C/T 2.5" In-Ceiling Speakers (Pair, New)

comparisons.notes: JBL Control 442C/T (JBL-C442C/T), new, in stock; listed at $225.36 each, sold as a pair, so $450.72 per pair

writeup: Woot has a new pair of JBL Professional Control 442C/T compact in-ceiling satellite speakers (model JBL-C442C/T, UPC 691991043208) for $89.99. These 2.5-inch, 15-watt speakers have 160-degree coverage and a 70V/100V transformer for commercial or whole-home audio, and PCNation charges $225.36 each, sold as a pair, for the same model. Woot showed only one left when we checked.
